title: My Archival Ink collection with Ranger is here
excerpt: It's finally here! My Archival Ink collection with Ranger launched on October 23, and some of you guessed it from the sneak peek. You were right! Twelve happy colors, with names like Peel the Joy, Cherry on Top, Bananas!, and Blueberry Bestie, in three ink sets.
body:
It's finally here! My Archival Ink collection with Ranger launched on October 23, and some of you guessed it from the sneak peek. You were right!

I made a video all about the new collection!

Twelve happy colors, with names like Peel the Joy, Cherry on Top, Bananas!, and Blueberry Bestie, in three ink sets. They're acid free, permanent, and waterproof, so they're ready for your journal, your planner, and everything in between. You can see the whole collection on Ranger's site.

As a little launch gift, the first 100 people who ordered all three ink sets got an exclusive stamp set I designed just for this launch, free.

I can't wait to see what you make with them, so tag me!

Also, I was a guest on the Wilder Possibilities podcast with Shelton Wilder, talking about turning creativity into a business and the 3 F's of success. Watch it on YouTube, or listen on Apple Podcasts, Spotify, or Amazon Music.

source.notes: Time-bound items: (1) Dropped the '9am PT / 12pm ET, set an alarm' launch-time line and rewrote 'launches today' as 'launched on October 23'. (2) The free stamp set for the first 100 buyers of all three ink sets is now past tense ('got'); please confirm with Amy whether the offer is still running or sold out, and adjust or drop that paragraph. Dropped the 'Hi friend' greeting, 'xo, Amy' sign-off, and the logo image. The source's three collection images were each linked to the Ranger collection page; I kept the images plain per the figure format and added one inline Ranger link in the text. The P.S. podcast mention is kept as a closing paragraph with a small 'Also,' connector; it could be split into its own post if preferred. Tags: 'Podcast' covers the Wilder Possibilities mention. The image src URLs are Klaviyo CDN links from the source; consider re-hosting them if the Journal prefers its own image storage. The exclamation points (including 'Bananas!') are all from Amy's source text.
